name: Spellcasting
description: You cast Sorcerer spells using Charisma. You know 4 cantrips (5 at level 4, 6 at level 10) and prepare a list of spells that grows as you level; when you gain a Sorcerer level you can replace one prepared spell and one cantrip. You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus.

name: Innate Sorcery
description: As a Bonus Action, you can unleash your inner magic for 1 minute. During that time the spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1, and you have Advantage on the attack rolls of your Sorcerer spells. You can do this twice, regaining both uses on a Long Rest.

name: Font of Magic
description:
You have a number of Sorcery Points equal to your Sorcerer level, and you regain them all on a Long Rest.
Converting spell slots: you can spend a spell slot (no action required) to gain Sorcery Points equal to its level.
Creating spell slots: as a Bonus Action, you can turn Sorcery Points into one spell slot: 2 points for level 1, 3 for level 2, 5 for level 3, 6 for level 4, and 7 for level 5. You can't create a slot above level 5, and created slots vanish when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Metamagic
description: You learn two Metamagic options, which let you spend Sorcery Points to alter spells as you cast them. You gain two more at level 10 and two more at level 17, and you can replace one option whenever you gain a Sorcerer level. You can use only one option on a spell unless an option says otherwise. The options are Careful Spell, Distant Spell, Empowered Spell, Extended Spell, Heightened Spell, Quickened Spell, Seeking Spell, Subtle Spell, Transmuted Spell, and Twinned Spell.

name: Sorcerer Subclass
description: You choose a subclass: Aberrant Sorcery, Clockwork Sorcery, Draconic Sorcery, or Wild Magic Sorcery. You gain its features at levels 3, 6, 14, and 18.

name: Ability Score Improvement
description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for. You gain this again at levels 8, 12, and 16.

name: Sorcerous Restoration
description: When you finish a Short Rest, you can regain spent Sorcery Points, up to half your Sorcerer level (rounded down). You can't do this again until you finish a Long Rest.

name: Sorcery Incarnate
description: If you have no uses of Innate Sorcery left, you can activate it by spending 2 Sorcery Points when you take the Bonus Action. Also, while Innate Sorcery is active, you can use up to two Metamagic options on each spell you cast.

name: Epic Boon
description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Dimensional Travel is the suggested choice.

name: Arcane Apotheosis
description: While Innate Sorcery is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.

name: Psionic Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Sorcerer level. Level 3: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Sliver. Level 5: Hunger of Hadar, Sending. Level 7: Evard's Black Tentacles, Summon Aberration. Level 9: Rary's Telepathic Bond, Telekinesis.

name: Telepathic Speech
description: As a Bonus Action, choose a creature you can see within 30 feet. You and it can speak telepathically while within a number of miles of each other equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). To understand each other, you each need to use a language the other knows. The link lasts for a number of minutes equal to your Sorcerer level and ends early if you use this on a different creature.

name: Psionic Sorcery
description: When you cast a level 1 or higher spell from your Psionic Spells, you can pay for it with a spell slot as usual or with Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level. Cast with Sorcery Points, the spell needs no Verbal or Somatic components, and no Material components unless they are consumed or have a listed cost.

name: Psychic Defenses
description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition.

name: Revelation in Flesh
description:
As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 or more Sorcery Points to transform your body for 10 minutes. You gain one benefit per point spent:
Aquatic Adaptation: a Swim Speed equal to twice your Speed, and the ability to breathe underwater.
Glistening Flight: a Fly Speed equal to your Speed, and you can hover.
See the Invisible: you can see Invisible creatures within 60 feet.
Wormlike Movement: you can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch, and you can spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints or the Grappled condition.

name: Warping Implosion
description: As a Magic action, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet. Each creature within 30 feet of the space you left makes a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it takes 3d10 Force damage and is pulled straight toward the space you left, stopping as close to it as possible. On a success, it takes half the damage only. You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending 5 Sorcery Points (no action required).

name: Clockwork Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Sorcerer level. Level 3: Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Evil and Good. Level 5: Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy. Level 7: Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct. Level 9: Greater Restoration, Wall of Force.

name: Restore Balance
description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet is about to roll a d20 with Advantage or Disadvantage, you can use your Reaction to stop the roll from being affected by either. You have a number of uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) and regain them on a Long Rest.

name: Bastion of Law
description: As a Magic action, you can spend 1 to 5 Sorcery Points to place a ward on yourself or another creature you can see within 30 feet. The ward holds a number of d8s equal to the points spent. When the warded creature takes damage, it can spend any number of those dice, roll them, and reduce the damage by the total. The ward lasts until you finish a Long Rest or use this feature again.

name: Trance of Order
description: As a Bonus Action, you enter a state of clockwork focus for 1 minute. Attack rolls against you can't benefit from Advantage, and whenever you make a D20 Test you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10. You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending 5 Sorcery Points (no action required).

name: Clockwork Cavalcade
description:
As a Magic action, you summon spirits of order in a 30-foot Cube originating from you. They do all of the following:
Heal: they restore up to 100 Hit Points, divided as you choose among creatures of your choice in the Cube.
Repair: damaged objects entirely in the Cube are repaired instantly.
Dispel: every spell of level 6 or lower ends on creatures and objects of your choice in the Cube.
You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending 7 Sorcery Points (no action required).

name: Draconic Resilience
description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and by 1 more each time you gain another Sorcerer level. Also, while you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

name: Draconic Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Sorcerer level. Level 3: Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath. Level 5: Fear, Fly. Level 7: Arcane Eye, Charm Monster. Level 9: Legend Lore, Summon Dragon.

name: Elemental Affinity
description: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. You have Resistance to that damage type, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of the spell.

name: Dragon Wings
description: As a Bonus Action, you sprout draconic wings for 1 hour or until you dismiss them (no action required). While they last, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet. You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending 3 Sorcery Points (no action required).

name: Dragon Companion
description: You can cast Summon Dragon without a Material component, and once per Long Rest without a spell slot. Whenever you start casting it, you can make it need no Concentration; if you do, it lasts 1 minute for that casting.

name: Wild Magic Surge
description: Once per turn, right after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, you can roll 1d20. On a 20, you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a random magical effect. If that effect is a spell, it is too wild to be changed by your Metamagic.

name: Tides of Chaos
description: You can give yourself Advantage on one D20 Test before you roll. You can do this once per Long Rest. Before then, casting a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot restores the use, but when it does you automatically roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

name: Bend Luck
description: Right after another creature you can see rolls a d20 for a D20 Test, you can use your Reaction and spend 1 Sorcery Point to roll 1d4 and apply the result as a bonus or a penalty to that roll.

name: Controlled Chaos
description: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and use either result.

name: Tamed Surge
description: Right after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, you can pick an effect from the Wild Magic Surge table in place of rolling on it. You can choose any effect except the table's final row, and if the effect involves a roll, you must make it. You can do this once per Long Rest.
